title: gelseminum speciosum
intro: Gelseminum speciosum, commonly known as Yellow Moonseed or Chinese Yellow Moonseed, is a plant species in the family Gelsemiaceae. It is a climbing woody vine native to China, which has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The plant is believed to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antipyretic effects, and its extracts have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective activities. The bioactive constituents of Gelseminum speciosum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, analgesic, and anticonvulsant effects.
